Key Findings

  • WebP q=70 is ~10x smaller than GIF while achieving nearly identical visual quality (SSIM 0.998 vs 0.999)
  • WebP q=90 exceeds GIF quality (43 dB vs 39 dB PSNR) at 1/5th the file size
  • APNG is lossless but largest — 47% bigger than GIF on average, best for archival only
  • GIF's 256-color palette causes visible color banding in gradients and natural imagery
  • All formats support animation in modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari 14+, Edge)
  • For documentation, WebP q=70 delivers the best quality-per-byte — 98.4% of GIF's SSIM at 10% of its file size
